critical_items.note: Issuer, intermediary and offering terms are confirmed in the Form C XML and PDF. The XML deadline and the PDF's '120 days after launch' differ.
Common Stock; non-voting in practice because of a 10-year irrevocable proxy to the Executive Chairman.
Subscription agreement (Exhibit B) is in the pack and readable. The Charter is referenced but not included.
The common stock is priced at $1.00 per share (arbitrary), with no valuation cap. The existing notes' conversion price is not specified numerically.
Minimum investment of $500 and issuer-paid intermediary fees are cited. Investor-side fees are not found.
Audited statements for FY ended 2025-12-31 and 2024-12-31 are in the pack; the audit report is dated June 11, 2026. Later cash is a single issuer figure at 2026-06-18.
No platform page or closing evidence is in the pack. The pack's own checklist shows availability as unknown and says a future deadline does not prove availability.

missing_information: Platform deal page, launch date, current raise amount, and whether the offering is live or has closed (no closing reported in pack).
Numeric Conversion Price, valuation cap and discount, and the definition of 'liquidity event' for the two convertible notes.
Issuer Certificate of Incorporation/Charter and bylaws (dividend, liquidation and other share-class terms are referred to the Charter).
Monthly burn and a current runway basis: the June 18, 2026 cash figure is a single dated issuer figure, with no matching expense data.
Explanation of the $0 FY2025 R&D expense versus the described mouse study, and who paid for the study.
Mouse study design details: sample size, controls, endpoints, and any independent or published report.
Evidence of IRB, FDA IND status, device regulatory pathway, and any clinical-site agreements; none is documented in the pack.
Patent filing/assignment records and the status of the US patent applications.
Reconciliation of the 1-share balance sheet with 75,000,001 shares, and ratification details.
Terms of the founder's related-party payable repayment and any founder funding commitments.
Prior experience of the management team in clinical-trial, regulatory or device commercialization.
